q: By the end of 2027, talks on the Korean Peninsula with all four countries (the United States, China, South Korea, and North Korea) taking part are held at least once
basis: Tests whether a four-party framework of the United States, China, and the two Koreas materializes. In the past 30 years, the only talks among these four countries alone were the Geneva four-party talks of December 1997 to August 1999, and the peace talks specified in the agreements of 2005, 2007, and 2018 were never held.
